description: Intent i003 (unclamped-wire-count, snapshot s01) complete. FINDING (low confidence): drivers/accel/qaic/qaic_control.c:1449-1462, resp_worker() orphan-response path. Untrusted source: MHI device/QSM control-channel responses (qaic_mhi_dl_xfer_cb at lines 1490-1512 validates only transaction_status and magic_number, then queues resp_worker) — a remote peer of a virtual-bus protocol. Violated invariant: the peer-supplied le32 msg->hdr.count (line 1449) is consumed with no clamp, and msg->hdr.len (line 1450) is never checked against the 4K DL buffer (kmalloc(QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH) at line 1063; QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH=SZ_4K, include/uapi/drm/qaic_accel.h:17); the loop at 1454 advances len only by peer trans_hdr->len (1460/1462), so a device reply with hdr.len=0xFFFFFF00 drives (struct wire_trans_hdr *)(msg->data+len) (line 1457) to a wild pointer dereferenced at 1458, and hdr.len==0 with count>1 spins forever. Asymmetric validation: the paired request/decode path enforces the clamps — qaic_manage():1256-1258 rejects count > QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH/sizeof(hdr) and len > QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH, decode_message():976-993 bounds msg_hdr_len and size_add(msg_len, hdr_len) — but this mirror path (orphaned responses matching no pending xfer) enforces none. Unsafe use verified in source. Counterevidence: decode_deactivate's dbc_id check is only reached after the OOB read; impact bounded to a 4-byte speculative wild read or DoS and requires a malicious/compromised MHI device peer; no runtime reproducer (read-only snapshot, MHI hardware needed) — hence low confidence. SAFE classifications: qaic decode_message:979 (clamped by qaic_manage:1256-1258 plus per-transaction checks, 4K kzalloc destination), net/can/bcm.c:1130 (nframes clamped to MAX_NFRAMES+1 on RX and [1,MAX_NFRAMES] at TX line 941 in s01), drivers/usb/usbip/usbip_common.c:482 (seed subsystem present but already carries the upstream fix: rpdu->number_of_packets clamped against urb->number_of_packets at 482-484, np<=0||np>USBIP_MAX_ISO_PACKETS check with urb->number_of_packets=0 reset and kcalloc in recv_iso at 686-699; excluded from reporting per seed rule). LIMITATIONS: sweep halted by finalize directive after deep-reading qaic/CAN-BMC/usbip; netlink nla_parse handlers (mt76/ath10k testmode counts, wireguard, ovpn, netkit), bluetooth hci_event, ksmbd/cifs/9p/nbd reply parsers, virtio/vhost, HID descriptors, io_uring were enumerated but not deep-read; reported impact (device-controlled wild read/DoS via orphaned response) is unproven end-to-end.
